requirements.text: AfterQuery is looking for experts with experience in software engineering, computer science, or app/web development to help train and evaluate AI models. This is a remote, project-based role: qualify once through a single assessment and receive ongoing project matches spanning code review, evaluation, and original task creation. Pay ranges from $50 to $100/hour depending on the projects you qualify into.
2+ years of real-world software engineering experience (full-time or substantive internships count)
Strong fundamentals in at least one major programming language
Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to work independently
